Layout: one horizontal row of exactly four distinct, evenly spaced, full-body animation poses, one pose in each equal-width cell; designed for final 1024x256 strip. Face and body point RIGHT in profile in all four frames. Same character, same anatomy and scale in every pose; keep the full silhouette inside its cell with at least 16px safe margin after normalization. Flat solid #FF00FF magenta background, no ground shadow. No words, symbols, labels, numbers, panel lines, borders, blood, detached limbs, or duplicate characters. Preserve armor details and crescent crest without adding a back banner. Crisp painted anime-realistic Sengoku arcade sprite with clean dark outlines, consistent detail, no motion blur or special effects.
